name: Masskara Marathon 2026
short_description: A multi-distance road race in Bacolod City, Philippines, taking place on September 27, 2026.
ai_summary: The Masskara Marathon 2026 is scheduled for September 27, 2026, in Bacolod City, Philippines, organized by SMOKE10 Events. The event offers four distance options: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, a 10 km race, and a 5 km race. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (5K, 10K, half marathon, full marathon) to suit different runner levels
Hosted in Bacolod City, a well-known Philippine destination
Organized by an established events company, SMOKE10 Events
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are unavailable

excerpt_quotes.quote: They served chicken, piaya, some fruits and candies at the turn around point but I would love it more if they have ice-cold water and energy drink along the route.

excerpt_quotes.quote: It was so hot but I had a great time running.

research_highlights: Masskara Marathon 2026 offers four distances: 42KM Full Marathon, 21KM Half Marathon, 10KM, and 5KM, starting/organized around the New Government Center in Bacolod.
The race is timed to coincide with Bacolod's MassKara Festival season, giving it a festival-like atmosphere with color and community energy.
Race is organized annually by SMOKE10 Events Management, with past editions (2023, 2024) also held in late September/early October at the Bacolod City Government Center.
On-site registration in past editions has been available at stores like Toby's Sports (SM City Bacolod) and Adidas outlets, alongside online registration.
A runner recap from an earlier Masskara Half Marathon edition described the race as very hot, indicating warm race-day conditions typical for Bacolod in this season.
research_watchouts: One participant reported that hydration along the course was limited to fruits, candies and food at the turnaround point, wishing for ice-cold water and energy drinks along the route rather than just at aid stops.
A runner explicitly noted the heat during the race, suggesting participants should prepare for hot conditions typical of a Bacolod-area race.
